name: Default
shortDescription: Camera streaming server that restreams RTSP, ONVIF, HomeKit and other camera feeds to the browser as WebRTC, MSE, HLS or MJPEG, with a Basic auth protected web UI.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the GO2RTC_PASSWORD value from the environment variables. Anyone with access to the API can run commands inside the container through exec sources, so keep this password private.

Cameras must be reachable from this server, so cameras on a home network need a VPN or port forward. Only the web port is published: WebRTC (8555) and the RTSP restream (8554) are not, so browser playback falls back to MSE, HLS or MJPEG over HTTPS.
